title.zh: 重复请求与并发一致性

brief.zh: 报名库存只有少量名额，但客户端会并发与重试。以幂等键、身份和数量约束请求，拒绝同键换人或换载荷，保证不重复扣减、不超卖、失败不半提交。
brief.en: A booking owner has two seats and retried requests. Preserve idempotency, reject changed payloads under a reused key and avoid overselling or partial commits.

zh: 副作用、事务和恢复说明
en: concurrent request tests and an invariant report

zh: 重复请求不重复业务效果
并发占用和中途失败按契约保持状态
en: Reconcile the complete result with the supplied input IDs and values.
Replaying a key must not reserve seats twice. This is a blocking regression.

failure.zh: 先返回成功后写入失败或同请求重复扣减应被捕获
failure.en: Replaying a key must not reserve seats twice.

zh: 不把某种幂等方案写成通用唯一答案
en: Locate the decision and supporting input/result in your deliverables.
Explain remaining uncertainty, your contribution and what the receiving role must verify.

environment.scope: Original small deterministic teaching application; no real enterprise traffic or model inference

zh: 报名库存只有少量名额，但客户端会并发与重试。以幂等键、身份和数量约束请求，拒绝同键换人或换载荷，保证不重复扣减、不超卖、失败不半提交。
先返回成功后写入失败或同请求重复扣减应被捕获；先制作能暴露这项错误的最小检查。
逐个核对输入和产物位置，保留修订前后、本人贡献与尚未验证范围。
en: A booking owner has two seats and retried requests.
Reproduce this failure first: Replaying a key must not reserve seats twice.
Check every result ID and preserve a before/after record; explain what this fixture cannot establish.

variants.scope: Fixed reviewed scenario and explicit extension. New constraints require a new review.
